description: Erection of a new mixed use building (4-storeys plus penthouse level) comprising of A1 retail use on the ground floor and 16 residential units to the upper floors with basement level car parking and associated landscaping on the pavement/highway
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (0920 PL01 Rev. B, 0920 EX.01 Rev. A, 0920 EX.02 Rev. A, 0920 EX.03 Rev. A, 0920 EX.04 Rev. A, 0920 PL.02 Rev. B, 0920 PL.11 Rev. D, 0920 PL.12 Rev. C, 0920 PL.13 Rev. C, 0920 PL.14 Rev. D, 0920 PL.15 Rev. C, 0920 PL.16 Rev. C 

Received: 19th May 2011

0920/PL.10 Rev. F, 0920 PL.20 Rev. D, 0920 PL.21 Rev. D, 0920 PL.22 Rev. D, 0920 PL.23 Rev. D, 0920 PL.24 Rev. D, 0920 PL.25 Rev. D, 0920 PL.26 Rev. D, 0920 PL.27 Rev. D, 0920 PL.28 Rev. D

Received: 11th August 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the buildings hereby approved have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of any part of the development accommodation a total of 16 secure cycle parking spaces for residents and 7 for staff of the commercial units shall be provided within the basement and made available for use, and retained thereafter to the occupiers of the development. Details of the cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of the first residential unit and the arrangements for cycle storage shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given unless agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Two (2) of the residential units (Units 01-5 and 02-5) in the building hereby approved shall be designed so that they can be easily adaptable to meet the National Wheelchair Housing Association Group (NATWHAG) Wheelchair Housing Standards. Details of compliance with this requirement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of work above ground. The approved details shall be implemented before each unit is occupied and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 9 - No excavation, demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08:00 to 18:00 on Mondays to Friday and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - No development above ground shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Hard landscaping details shall include hard surfacing materials, proposed finished levels or contours, means of enclosure and boundary treatments, vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas, minor artefacts and structures (e.g. benches, lighting, CCTV, works of art etc.), walls, gates and fences.  
Soft landscaping details shall include proposed finished levels or contours, planting plans, written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment), plant schedules (noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities) and tree pits and species proposed to be planted therein and measures to ensure protection from services routes.

All landscape work shall be completed prior to occupation of the building and retained and maintained thereafter.

If within a period of five years from the date of planting any tree or specimen shrub that tree or specimen shrub or any tree or specimen shrub planted in replacement for it is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree or specimen shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written approval to any variation.

Condition : 11 - No development shall commence until details of privacy treatments to windows and balconies of the south elevation of the building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details as approved shall have been implemented prior to occupation of the buildings and retained and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 12 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - No development shall commence until the local authority (as the Highway Authority) has approved in writing full details of works affecting the public highway including: 
i) Construction of the proposed building inclusive of the basement, covering structural works and support for adjoining land
ii) New pavement surfacing
iii) Any proposed street tree planting
iv) Maintenance of pedestrian access on the footpath past the site during construction.

The approved works shall be completed in accordance with the local planning authority's written approval and have been certified in writing as complete on behalf of the local planning authority prior to occupation of any unit within the development.

Condition : 14 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional, giving specific details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land and the public highway based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. The statement shall include details of:
i) Construction of the proposed building inclusive of the basement, covering structural works
ii) New pavement surfacing
iii) Tree planting
iv) Maintenance of pedestrian access on the footpath past the site during construction.

The approved works shall be completed in accordance with the local planning authority's written approval and have been certified in writing as complete on behalf of the local planning authority prior to occupation of any unit within the development.

Condition : 15 - The A1 use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:

8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, and 10:00am to 5:00pm on Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 16 - No development shall take place until a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from poor external air quality has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme, once approved, shall be implemented prior to occupation unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and be retained thereafter.

Condition : 17 - No development shall take place until a detailed scheme of on-site sustainability covering the following items has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The details as approved shall be implemented prior to occupation of the building, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and retained thereafter:
(a)	measures for the harvesting of rainwater and the minimisation of water run-off;
(b)	grey water reuse as appropriate; 
(c)	the sourcing of materials to be used in the construction and fitting out (involving reuse, recycling and other sustainable sourcing); and
(d)	an energy assessment has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority which demonstrates how the hierarchy of energy efficiency, efficient supply of energy and renewable energy generation has been observed. The assessment should show that a reduction in CO2 emissions of at least 25% from the 2010 Building Regulations will be achieved. CO2 emissions figures should be calculated using SAP (Standard Assessment Procedure)/ SBEM (Simplified Building Energy Model) and the associated worksheets should be submitted as part of the application, alongside full details of the proposed energy efficiency measures and renewable energy technologies.
The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs
and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local
Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been
carried out in accordance with the approved details.
